text: [Music]
in this video you'll learn to administer
first aid to a person who has just
broken their
arm tell the person not to move their
arm and to support it without bending or
extending
it use the victim upper garment such as
a t-shirtt or a sweater to hold the limb
securely in one place this will help to
prevent the fracture from
worsening you can also secure the limb
in one place with the aid of a
scarf call the emergency services or a
doctor especially if it's an open
fracture and follow their
indications if the victim is wearing any
jewelry in contact with affected limb
carefully remove it do not give the
victim anything to eat or drink
